 The Los Angeles Lakers became the first team to reach 10 wins this NBA season following their victory over the Atlanta Hawks on Monday. The game also marked Sandro Mamukelashvili's best performance in a Lakers uniform so far, earning him recognition from head coach JJ Redick .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement During the postgame press conference, Redick praised Mamukelashvili's impressive contribution and the forward-center for making several crucial plays throughout the game.
 "Sandro, his best game as a Lakers and whatever, he had 23 points," Redick said. "That was awesome. Made some big-time plays. I thought the two defensive rebounds he got there in the last few minutes were as big as any play he made all night."

 While Luka Doncic was undoubtedly the real hero behind Monday's victory , Mamukelashvili also played a significant role in helping Los Angeles secure the win.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He finished the game with 23 points, eight rebounds, and three assists in 32 minutes, shooting 7-of-13 from the field and an impressive 5-of-8 from beyond the arc. He also converted all four of his free-throw attempts and recorded a plus-20 rating, the best mark among Lakers players.
 It was a season-high scoring performance for Mamukelashvili and a particularly valuable contribution with the Lakers missing Austin Reaves, who was sidelined due to illness.
 Mamukelashvili entered the 2021 NBA Draft, where the Indiana Pacers selected him with the 54th overall pick in the second round. However, the Pacers traded his draft rights to the Milwaukee Bucks on draft night, allowing him to begin his professional career in Milwaukee.
 Besides his stint with the Bucks, Mamukelashvili also played for the San Antonio Spurs and Toronto Raptors before joining the Lakers during the offseason. He agreed to a four-year, $52 million contract with Los Angeles.
 Click Here to Subscribe The move represents a significant milestone for the Georgian forward-center, who gradually earned a larger role in the league through his performances. Through 12 games of the 2026-27 season, Mamukelashvili is averaging 9.8 points, 4.6 rebounds, and 1.6 assists per game for Los Angeles.
